evidence.claim: Official metric descriptors include generativelanguage.googleapis.com/quota/{generate_content_free_tier_requests,generate_content_free_tier_input_token_count,generate_requests_per_model,generate_content_paid_tier_input_token_count}/usage and /limit, plus tier 2/3 variants. Request/token usage is DELTA, limit GAUGE; labels include model and limit_name, usage also method; up to 150 seconds visibility delay.
The generativelanguage.googleapis.com/Location monitored resource exposes resource_container and location, rather than consumed_api.project_id.
AI Studio usage requires monitoring.timeSeries.list; rate-limit dashboard additionally requires cloudquotas.quotas.get; project lookup requires resourcemanager.projects.get.
QuotaInfo list is a documented read endpoint with cloud-platform OAuth scope and cloudquotas.quotas.get IAM permission.
QuotaInfo exposes quotaId, metric, dimensions, refreshInterval, isPrecise, isConcurrent and dimension-specific configurations.
DimensionsInfo.details.value is the currently enforced value; dimension-specific entries override general entries, and applicableLocations retains location coverage.
Gemini quotas are project-wide and model-dependent; RPD resets at Pacific midnight; RPM/TPM and additional spend/priority limits can also apply.
Service Usage consumerQuotaMetrics.list is an alternative quota-configuration read with effective/default limits, unit and overrides; it requires serviceusage.quotas.get.
Google supports registered public Desktop OAuth, system browser, PKCE, loopback callback and token refresh; installed apps lack incremental authorization.
Google OAuth refresh tokens can expire or be revoked; external Testing projects with non-basic scopes can issue refresh tokens expiring after seven days.
Production apps require relevant identity, domain, minimum-scope and verification compliance; protocol support does not establish a registered or approved lain client.
Monitoring timeSeries.list accepts monitoring.read, monitoring or cloud-platform; a filter must identify the requested metric type.
Gemini documents OAuth instead of an API key, desktop credential setup, Bearer requests and x-goog-user-project; quickstart scope example is cloud-platform plus generative-language.retriever.
Generic API-key creation is a cloud-platform-authorized write requiring apikeys.keys.create and returns an operation.
Resource Manager projects.search lists accessible projects with resourcemanager.projects.get; explicit project selection remains necessary.
Enabling a Google API is a separate serviceusage.services.enable write operation.

Since May 28, 2026 new AI Studio keys are service-account-bound authorization keys. Creation needs service-account and binding permissions beyond ordinary API-key creation; unrestricted standard keys are rejected.

Official Billing Usage v2 GET /accounts/{id}/billable/usage is Alpha Restricted, gives daily usage including free-tier metered consumption, fields for quantities/units/metric IDs, and a 31-day maximum range. Specific Workers-AI coverage is not established.
Billing Usage v1 depends on including the subscription billing-cycle anchor; it is not an established near-real-time daily allowance source.
Cloudflare supports third-party desktop/CLI Authorization Code with S256 PKCE and token auth none; public distribution requires client registration and verified client-URL domain.
Client registration supports refresh_token grant and automatic offline_access. Dot-delimited OAuth API scopes are validated; colon scopes are not accepted.
Official third-party OAuth endpoints are dash.cloudflare.com/oauth2/auth, token and revoke, with public metadata endpoints documented.
Consent selects account resources and optional scopes; administrators can prevent new public OAuth authorizations.
Workers AI REST quickstart uses Bearer token plus account ID, and says custom tokens require Workers AI Read and Edit.
Official GraphQL Analytics token guide requests Account Analytics Read.
API-token provisioning requires separate permission to create additional tokens; a normal inference/monitor grant does not imply that power.
Cloudflare documents capturing dashboard GraphQL requests for investigation; this can support source qualification without making cookie scraping the product interface.
